args.title: Use environment variable for base URL in password reset email
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link currently uses a BASE_URL constant that defaults to "http://localhost:3000" when the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the link in the email to incorrectly point to localhost in production environments if PUBLIC_URL is missing.

The change proposed is to ensure that the BASE_URL is correctly set from the environment variable PUBLIC_URL and to update any relevant documentation or configuration to guarantee PUBLIC_URL is set in deployment environments. This will prevent the password reset email from sending links pointing to localhost and instead use the correct public URL for the service.
